attacks.name: Fire Stream
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

power.name: Firestarter
power.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

power.name: Natural Cure
power.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, remove all Special Conditions from it.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of their deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Powerful Friends
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Attack Operation
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Houndour in play.

power.name: Smooth Over
power.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a card, shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

attacks.name: Energy Drink
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

power.name: Fresh Squeezed
power.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stunning Likeness
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may use the effect of a Supporter card you find there as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.name: Big Malasada
cards.text: Heal 20 damage and remove a Special Condition from your Active Pokémon. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Copycat
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Guzma
cards.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. If you do, switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Kahili
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Then, flip a coin. If heads, if you played this Kahili from your hand, put this card into your hand instead of the discard pile. If you have no cards in your deck, you can't play this card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Lillie
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. If it's your first turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Mallow
cards.text: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, and put those cards on top of your deck in any order. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nest Ball
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Pokémon Fan Club
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Professor Kukui
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Rescue Stretcher
cards.text:
Choose 1:
• Put a Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
• Shuffle 3 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Sightseer
cards.text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand. Then, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If you can't draw any cards in this way, you can't play this card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: TV Reporter
cards.text: Draw 3 cards. Then, discard a card from your hand. If you have no cards in your deck, you can't play this card. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Tate & Liza
cards.text:
Choose 1:
• Shuffle your hand into your deck then draw 5 cards.
• Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Timer Ball
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Ultra Ball
cards.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).
